stemMd: A survey team chooses one vehicle. Alder costs90 euros and carries4 people; Birch costs120 and carries6; Cedar costs150 and carries8; Elm costs100 and carries5. Ignore all other costs. In column "five", choose the cheapest vehicle carrying at least5 people. In column "seven", choose the cheapest carrying at least7.
instructionsMd: Select exactly one answer in each named column. Both selections must be correct. The project presents separate column lists rather than the official interface’s shared matrix or drop-down controls.
explanationMd: For five people, Elm,Birch,Cedar qualify, and Elm has the lowest cost100. For seven, only Cedar qualifies. Capacity must be checked before minimizing cost.

distractorRationale.five-a: Birch costs more than eligible Elm.
distractorRationale.five-b: Cedar costs more than eligible Elm.
